metadata.case_name: LAU CHI LAM v. CARITAS-HONG KONG

plaintiff.occupation_before: Workman II (workman at the elderly home operated by Caritas)

injuries.description: soft tissue injury of Lau’s lower back
source: the clinical picture was compatible with soft tissue injury of Lau’s lower back.
injuries.icd_description: Strain or sprain of muscle, fascia or tendon of lower back

injuries.description: aggravation of pre-existing lumbar degenerative changes
source: X-ray and MRI done after the accident in 2007 revealed multiple lumbar level degenerative changes with no obvious theca sac or nerve root compression.

Degenerative changes with multiple marginal bone spurs, slightly narrowed L4/5 disc and mild degenerative scoliosis were confirmed. The experts agreed that the degeneration was a pre-existing condition.
injuries.icd_description: Injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: tenderness over the low back region
no neurological deficit over his lower limb
unable to walk for a long time or at quick pace
could not return to work or his pre-accident leisure of going fishing

treatments_received.treatment: Hospital attendance and admission after accident; ambulance transport; initial assessment and discharge
source: He was sent to the hospital by ambulance. Examination revealed tenderness over the low back region. There was no neurological deficit over his lower limb. X-ray of the lumbar spine showed normal alignment and no fracture. He was discharged 2 days later.

treatments_received.treatment: Re-admission to hospital for back pain; treatment and discharge; referral to orthopaedic department
source: Lau was subsequently re-admitted to the hospital for back pain. He was treated and discharged. He was referred to the orthopaedic department for further management.
During the period between early December 2007 and mid January 2008, he attended the department for several times for low back pain and was treated and discharged on each occasion.
He has since attended over 20 sessions of physiotherapy and over 10 sessions of occupational therapy.

treatments_received.treatment: Consultation with private doctor and bonesetter
